h1: Custom 1 2 Inch Wide Badge ID Holders
metaTitle: Custom 1 2 Inch Wide Badge ID Holders | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom 1 2 inch wide badge ID holders for secure, slim badges. Perfect for bulk orders. Get a fast quote today!
introHtml: Custom 1 2 inch wide badge ID holders are designed for badges that are narrower than standard, making them ideal for event credentials, conference passes, or access cards that need a snug fit. This specific width prevents badges from sliding around or flipping over, ensuring clear visibility of printed details. Available in clear vinyl or durable nylon, these holders can be customized with your logo through screen printing or debossing. Perfect for trade shows, corporate security, or school ID systems where a professional, secure presentation matters.
heroAltText: Custom 1 2 inch wide badge ID holders with clear vinyl pouch and lanyard for secure badge display
